title: Do minute, sirf saans
caption:
Jab neend nahi aati, tab aap kya karte hain? 👇
Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a young man lying awake before an interview who opens the Calm kit in Waypoint and follows two minutes of box breathing with a growing circle. Waypoint is for adults 18 and over and is not a counselling or crisis service.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Karan: Karan is a man of about twenty-four with short curly hair, a plain white t-shirt and tired eyes.
cast.Maa: Maa is Karan's mother, a woman in her fifties in a cotton saree with a gentle face.

scenes.vo: रात के दो बजे। कल इंटरव्यू। और नींद ग़ायब।
scenes.sub: Raat ke do baje. Kal interview. Aur neend ghaayab.
scenes.art: Karan lying awake in bed in a small moonlit room, staring at the ceiling fan, a formal shirt hanging on the cupboard door.
Karan turned on his side hugging a pillow, a wall clock showing two o'clock.

scenes.vo: दिमाग़ में एक ही सवाल, अगर नहीं हुआ तो?
scenes.sub: Dimaag mein ek hi sawaal, agar nahi hua toh?
scenes.art: Karan sitting up in bed with his hands in his hair, moonlight through the window.

scenes.vo: किसी को जगाना नहीं चाहता था।
scenes.sub: Kisi ko jagaana nahi chaahta tha.
scenes.art: Karan looking at the closed door of the next room where his family sleeps.

scenes.vo: उसने वेपॉइंट खोला। वहाँ कैल्म किट नाम की एक चीज़ थी।
scenes.sub: Usne Waypoint khola. Wahaan Calm kit naam ki ek cheez thi.
scenes.art: Karan sitting cross-legged on the bed with his phone glowing softly in his hands.

scenes.vo: एक गोला, जो धीरे धीरे बड़ा होता है। चार गिनती साँस अंदर।
scenes.sub: Ek gola, jo dheere dheere bada hota hai. Chaar ginti saans andar.

scenes.vo: चार रोको। चार बाहर। चार रुको। बस दो मिनट।
scenes.sub: Chaar roko. Chaar baahar. Chaar ruko. Bas do minute.

scenes.vo: करन ने गोले के साथ साँस ली।
scenes.sub: Karan ne gole ke saath saans li.
scenes.art: Karan with his eyes closed and shoulders relaxed, breathing in slowly, phone resting on his knee.

scenes.vo: सवाल वही था। पर सीना थोड़ा हल्का था।
scenes.sub: Sawaal wahi tha. Par seena thoda halka tha.
scenes.art: Karan lying back on the pillow with a calmer face, the phone face down beside him.

scenes.vo: सुबह माँ ने पूछा, नींद आई?
scenes.sub: Subah Maa ne poochha, neend aayi?
scenes.art: Maa handing Karan a cup of tea in a sunny kitchen, he is dressed in the formal shirt.

scenes.vo: करन मुस्कुराया, थोड़ी सी। काफ़ी थी।
scenes.sub: Karan muskuraaya, thodi si. Kaafi thi.
scenes.art: Karan smiling at Maa while tying his shoelaces at the door, morning light behind him.

scenes.vo: जब नींद नहीं आती, आप क्या करते हैं?
scenes.sub: Jab neend nahi aati, aap kya karte hain?
scenes.art: Close-up of Karan smiling at the viewer, sunny doorway softly blurred behind.
